reason: This page does not establish that API access is paid. Instead, it explicitly states that users installing apps in a HubSpot account must either be a Super Admin or have HubSpot Marketplace Access permissions. Therefore the first-pass value self_serve_paid is not supported by this source. The documented restriction is an account permission/admin requirement. This finding concerns permission to install/authorize the integration; the page does not by itself establish HubSpot's broader pricing or developer-plan requirements.

evidence.quote: Users installing apps in their HubSpot account must either be a Super Admin or have HubSpot Marketplace Access permissions.
